name: tool_get
description:
Load the full definition of a specific tool by name.

Returns: name, group, file path, full description, all parameters with types and descriptions, required fields, and which agents currently have this tool allocated.

Use this before tool_update to understand current state and blast radius (which agents will be affected by a description change).

name.description: Exact tool name/id as it appears in tool_list (e.g. delegate, session_search, bash).
